second-world-online:
In a luxurious room resembling a private ICU, a 20-year-old young man lay weakly on the bed, his body ravaged by advanced-stage leukemia that had been consuming him for the past two years. His body was fragile and nearly powerless, yet the flame of spirit in his eyes never flickered out. For him, games were the only escape from the prison of his flesh, a place where he could become anyone and do anything that was impossible in the real world.
When Chronos Tech released Second World Online (SWO), the latest generation Full-Dive game that fully transferred the player’s consciousness into a virtual world, a new hope emerged. SWO was not merely a game; it was the “Second World,” a place that felt truly real where even the paralyzed could run, fight, and experience true freedom.

After being betrayed and dying in the hands of her former family and friends, in the guise of a seemingly unprecedented accident, Ling Yu, the Apocalyptic Queen, found herself regressed back to thirteen years ago in the past.
Returning to her life when she was still 18 years old, the first thing Ling Yu did was sever the relationship with her so-called family and run to the countryside, to which they thought she had given up. Much less to say, Ling Yu returned full-fledged and started to do bizarre things, which made them think she had finally gone crazy.

The former Apocalyptic Queen!

the-billionaires-only-desire:

Maya DeLuca was born as a result of adultery. She is the fruit of the shameful love affair her married mother had. Her mother passed away shortly after giving birth, leaving Maya to bear the consequences of her mother's sins.
Right from birth, Maya was loathed by everyone in her family, especially her stepfather, her late mother’s husband. Maya is the evidence of his wife's betrayal; hence, she is a thorn in his flesh. He abused her, punishing her for her mother’s betrayal.

the-mage-who-wasnt-meant-to-be:
He wanted to see tomorrow. He never got the chance.
Anastasius was fifteen when he finally decided that he wanted to live.
After years of bullying, loneliness, and believing that his family would be better without him, he nearly ended his own life. But when his older brother reached out to him and his little sister sought comfort in him during a storm, something inside him changed.
For the first time, Anastasius wanted to see what tomorrow would bring.
He never got to.
The next day, a terrible accident claimed his life as he protected his younger sister with his own body.
But death was not the end.
Anastasius awakens in the body of Aric Noctra, the fifteen year old son of one of the most powerful noble families in the world.
Aric has been unconscious for three years.
His body is frail. His swordsmanship is pathetic compared to his legendary father. His life has been overshadowed by his siblings, and during three years of helpless consciousness, he grew bitter toward the family that never stopped loving him.
Now, two lives exist within one body.
One boy died believing nobody cared about him.
The other lived believing everyone had abandoned him.
Neither was entirely right.…

Hence, the 26-year-old emperor had never favored any of his consorts, let alone sired any heirs. The imperial harem constantly pressured him for offspring. The common people also yearned for a royal heir. When they learned that the tyrant held affection for Sangyan, the widow with the ill-fated destiny, the entire nation opposed their union.
Eventually, the entire country pleaded with Sangyan to bear children for the sickly and tyrannical emperor...
Beauty widow with a deadly fate VS Emperor with allergy to women

What kind of responsibility could a little kid who only plays in the mud take?

Moran, who has transmigrated into the Type-Moon universe, is determined to clear the game in one life!

When he woke up, he was bound to a chair, facing three creepy robed women and in a body way too young and way too weak to be his own. As he slowly came to, he realized that he was no longer in the same universe as he was before. He had teleported to the Kingdom of Helius, where an all-powerful church rules its lands and wages war against the elusive group known only as Mages. Armed with an incredibly cocky neural interface that just won’t shut up and his own sheer wit, our main character will find himself not just fighting to survive, but maybe even something bigger than himself.
